authorization.scope: User completed the manual export and asked to continue. A separate runner is being implemented; root reviews executable stage gates before model calls.
authorization.budgetScope: All research, creation, repair and transport attempts across both lanes, both tracks and all repeats of a prototype share its one cap. This is estimated API-equivalent cost, not a subscription invoice.

prototypes.currentResearchConfiguration: Verified local model/reasoning settings plus core research using the same configured model adapter. Discovery/acquisition is a separate source-adapter operation.

lanes.scope: Approved full Luffy direction, including its declared runtime Gear and Haki behavior.
lanes.qualification: Approved target behavior is development evidence; executable contract is pending.

lanes.scope: Regular towers, legal crosspaths, abilities and transformations derived from qualified BTD6 behavior; Paragons excluded until a later extension.
lanes.qualification: Luffy is the generation subject in both lanes. Captured BTD6 families qualify the lane contract; they are not substitute generation subjects. Compare the same intended adaptation while reporting lane constraints.

tracks.input: Subject, continuity, source evidence and a frozen concise user direction. Both prototypes receive the same direction.
Subject, continuity and source evidence. Exclude the approved design, its unique progression choices and evaluations from every prompt, example, retrieval result and research intermediate.
tracks.interpretation: Exploratory recovery of a withheld direction; source-faithful alternatives are not instruction failures. Luffy remains development evidence.

executionOrder: Pair prototypes within each lane/track/repeat. Alternate which prototype goes first across cells and repeats. Fresh context for every attempt; serialize calls for predictable accounting.

evidencePolicy.astraResearchMeaning: One Astra LOW agent conducts bounded tool-assisted source discovery/retrieval, evaluates evidence and creates the unit. All model turns count; no extra planner or higher-reasoning author is inserted.
evidencePolicy.lunaResearchMeaning: Current baseline uses the standard discovery/acquisition adapter, Luna HIGH research synthesis, then Luna HIGH creation. Research calls, source operations and failures count in end-to-end cost/latency.
evidencePolicy.sourceAccess: Freeze the same starting subject/continuity, permitted source universe or replayable retrieval service, acquisition limits and access permissions. The workflows may choose different evidence; record those differences instead of supplying a perfected research inventory.
evidencePolicy.creationOnlyControl: Optional future protocol revision may supply the identical factual43-claim record to both creation stages. That control is not the registered integrated research comparison.

futureImageResearchContract.comparisonRule: When enabled in a later frozen protocol, both prototypes receive the same image evidence opportunities and visual limitations. Do not invent successful acquisition now.

gpt-6-astra.reservationScope: Short context only, guaranteed by request byte bound plus4096 overhead <=204096 tokens. Full Fast2x plus cache-write1.25x input and regional1.1x allowances; no discount assumed. These are API-equivalent allowances, not claims about proxy billing.

gpt-5.6-luna.reservationScope: Short context only, guaranteed by request byte bound plus4096 overhead <=204096 tokens. Full Fast2x plus cache-write1.25x input and regional1.1x allowances; no discount assumed. These are API-equivalent allowances, not claims about proxy billing.

pricing.unknownUsage: Retain the complete pre-call reservation. Unknown usage is not zero.
pricing.discounts: Do not assume caching, batch, subscription or routing discounts. Verify long-context, output/reasoning-token and transport billing treatment for each model.

evaluation.decisionRule: Report paired differences and every failure separately by lane and track. No winner by acceptance count alone. Selection requires review of required behavior and uncertainty, not an invented scalar total.

manualExportHandoff.staticCapture: Reuse existing immutable capture only after confirming exact same installed game build.
manualExportHandoff.supplement: User runs main-menu Export Current Version once; Corpus verifies the fresh export against the static snapshot.
manualExportHandoff.qualification: Data capture and integrity checks do not establish DSL, runtime or transformation semantics.

directionFreeze.continuity: One Piece manga continuity, supplied identically as request metadata.
directionFreeze.limits: Generic direction and rubric are frozen now; schema-dependent author prompts and lane probes remain pending.

continuation.note: Preparation preregistration remains the matrix contract; actual readiness is checked by the separate runner. No live calls have been made.
